summary: Procure 25 Cypress E2E team seats + enterprise plugin; enable SSO and license billing
cost_estimate: $3,750/year (vendor quote: $150 per seat/year) + $1,200 enterprise plugin one-time
billing_account: Engineering Tools (ENG-OPS) - Cloud Tools budget code 7-ENG-TOOLS
vendor_contact: Cypress Sales - sales@cypress.io / Account rep: Jordan Meyers / +1-415-555-0199
description:
Issue summary:
Request to purchase 25 Cypress (e2e testing) team seats and an enterprise plugin license to support cross-team CI workflows. Includes SSO (SAML) enablement and corporate billing.

Impact:
- Multiple product teams (Platform, Web, Integrations) are blocked from standardizing on Cypress for cross-account E2E test suites due to lack of enterprise seats and SSO.
- Current ad-hoc personal licenses create maintenance overhead and inconsistent CI coverage.

Background:
- Pilot completed with 6 seats under a trial license (pilot ran Feb 2026). Pilot feedback recommends enterprise plugin for parallelization and analytics.
- Product QA and Platform teams estimate needing 20-30 seats; request anchored at 25 to cover immediate needs and contractors.

Request details / acceptance criteria:
- Purchase 25 named seats + enterprise plugin (one-time fee).
- Configure SAML SSO integration with Redwood IdP (Okta).
- Add ENG-OPS billing account as payer and confirm monthly invoicing cadence.
- Ensure service-account API key for CI is created and stored in Vault with appropriate rotation notes.
- Provide license keys and onboarding docs to Platform and QA leads.

Risks / Security notes:
- Need security sign-off on SAML attribute mappings (email, employee_id, groups).
- Enterprise plugin requires access to test artifacts; ensure retention and access controls align with retention policy.

Next steps requested from procurement team:
1) Validate vendor quote and ask for any available start-of-year discount or seat-tier pricing.
2) Create PO and route for Finance approval.
3) Coordinate SSO setup window with Security/Identity team.
4) Confirm Vault storage method and CI key policy with SRE.

Related internal context:
- Pilot notes (confluence): https://confluence.redwood.internal/display/QA/Cypress+Pilot+Feb+2026
- Refer to past licensing cleanup: INT-48211 (license-seat-transfer-and-unused-seat-audit-request)
steps_to_complete: 1) Procurement: request updated quote and discount; 2) Finance: approve PO and update billing; 3) Vendor: issue invoice and license bundle; 4) Identity: schedule SSO test and mapping review; 5) SRE: provision Vault secret and CI service account; 6) QA/Platform: validate license assignment and CI parallelization; 7) Close ticket after onboarding checklist completed.
